strings: r_c0 assures m_c that even if {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} voice gets stuck, {PRONOUN/r_c0/subject} will still be there to support {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
Sometimes m_c's voice feels stuck in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} chest, where the words clog and stifle {PRONOUN/m_c/object}. Sometimes its easier just not to talk at all.
When m_c gets stressed, {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} words just disappear, leaving behind a heavy feeling.
It's not unheard of for prismatic minds to be silent, so whenever m_c's voice leaves {PRONOUN/m_c/object}, {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates are ready to help.
